videos.title: How to fine-tune Llama models for structured extraction of data from images
videos.presenter: Beto de Paola
videos.presenterNote: From the card on Meta's listing. Meta's video page names no presenter, so this is unconfirmed.
videos.demonstrates: Fine-tuning a Llama vision model to turn document photos into JSON, measuring the base model first, and checking the tune didn't cost it other skills
videos.teaches: Fine-tunes Llama 3.2 11B Vision to turn photos of made-up W-2 tax forms into JSON. It scores the base model first, tunes with LoRA and with a full fine-tune, scores again, and checks the model kept its other skills. Meta reports W-2 accuracy of 58 for the base, 72 for LoRA and 98 for the full tune.

current.state: Receipt Form Reader has been live since Oct 28 as a schema-prompt app on Muse Spark 1.3. It runs no fine-tune, no baseline and no accuracy check, so it skips the lesson's method.

learn.title: Measure, tune, measure again: reading receipts
learn.plan: Score Muse Wonder field by field in code on 40 invented receipts, LoRA-tune Llama 3.2 3B on receipt text on one rented A10, score it against its base on the same 40, and say plainly that Muse Muse can't tune vision layers yet.
learn.tune: LoRA of Llama 3.2 3B on a Lambda A10, about $0.40 to $1.80, or a free Kaggle T4 (not run yet)
learn.estimate: About $3.40 to $8.80 with the Lambda tune, $3 to $7 with the free one
unverified: Muse Wonder's receipt score, cost per receipt and build cost
Muse Muse's own Llama tune path (TUNE_ANY_BASE is off); the 3B runs so far went through the test harness
The Jetson receipt bench scored receipt text, not photos

rebuild.plan: Do the video's method on receipts: measure first, tune, measure again, check nothing else broke. Muse Wonder reads the receipt photo into JSON and is scored field by field by code on 40 invented receipts whose answers are known. Then a LoRA of Llama 3.2 3B learns the text half (receipt text to the same JSON) on one rented A10, scored the same way against its base, with general checks to show it kept its other skills. Muse Muse can't tune a vision model yet, and the page says so.
rebuild.note: Read a photo of a receipt and give me the shop, date, subtotal, tax, total and how many items I bought as JSON, and show me how often each field comes out right

Catch rate and false blocks, until Prove it records them
